mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS nickname, u.is_author AS is_author FROM Novel_Reviews r JOIN integrated_user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.novel_id = #{novelId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) FROM Novel_Reviews WHERE novel_id = #{novelId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Novel_Reviews WHERE novel_id = #{novelId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Novel_Reviews WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Novel_Reviews (novel_id, user_id, review_text, rating) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{userId}, #{reviewText}, #{rating})
mapper.update: UPDATE Novel_Reviews SET likes = likes + 1 WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Review_Likes WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT rl.review_id FROM Review_Likes rl JOIN Novel_Reviews r ON rl.review_id = r.review_id WHERE r.novel_id = #{novelId} AND rl.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS nickname, u.is_author AS is_author FROM Novel_Reviews r JOIN integrated_user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.novel_id = #{novelId} AND r.likes > 0 ORDER BY r.likes DESC, r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.review_id AS comment_id, r.novel_id AS post_id, r.user_id AS user_id, r.review_text AS content, r.likes AS likes, r.created_at AS created_at, u.nickname AS nickname, u.is_author AS is_author, n.title AS post_title, 'review' AS board_key, 'review' AS type FROM Novel_Reviews r JOIN integrated_user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id JOIN Novels n ON r.novel_id = n.novel_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.review_id AS comment_id, r.novel_id AS post_id, r.user_id AS user_id, r.review_text AS content, r.likes AS likes, r.created_at AS created_at, u.nickname AS nickname, u.is_author AS is_author, n.title AS post_title, 'review' AS board_key, 'review' AS type FROM Novel_Reviews r JOIN integrated_user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id JOIN Novels n ON r.novel_id = n.novel_id
AND (r.review_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
